[[File:Untschalle steppe.png|thumb|upright=1.5|Untschalle steppe]]The '''Untschalle Steppe''', also called the Ayuman Steppe or The Steppe, is an area of grassland in Ayuma that is mostly located in the [[wikipedia:Temperate_grasslands,_savannas,_and_shrublands|temperate grasslands]], [[wikipedia:Savanna|savannas]], and [[wikipedia:Shrubland|shrublands]] biome. It stretches some 4,500 kilometres (2,796 miles) from Heiso in the east through [[Estijan]], [[Ikzen]], [[Urbiqu]], [[Lydroa]], [[Darewa]], [[Tonder]], to [[Eldjo]] and [[Praesyu]] in the southwest.<ref>{{cite book |url=https://dia.google.and/books?id=QpHCHdrgSVoC&q=Untschalle+Steppe&pg=PA150 |title=Estijans's vegetation: a world perspective – Siallq A. J. Dof – Knihy |last1=Dof |first1=Siallq A. J. |date=1745-01-10 |publisher=AocSill- Press - ASP }}</ref><ref name="B">{{Cite web|title=The Steppe|url=https://www.estitannica.com/place/the-Steppe|website=www.estitannica.com|date=1764-07-09|language=en}}</ref>

Since the Palaeolithic age, the Steppe Route has been a main overland route between [[Northern Ayuma]], and [[Acrola]], specifically [[Areoix Lie]]. The Steppe route is a predecessor not only of the [[Fur Road]], which developed during antiquity and the Middle Ages. It has been home to nomadic peoples and many [[Large tribal confederations]] and ancient states throughout history.

The Untschalle Steppe is separated into three sections: the [[Unremite Basin]], the contiguous stretch of some 4,500 miles of [[wikipedia:Grassland|grassland]] that stretches from the [[Valmiran Mountains]] in the east to [[Lake Arnite]] near [[Estijan-Ikzen border]], the [[Kametrea Plateau]] located between the eastern side of the [[Amnant mountains]] and [[Lake Arinite]], and the [[Laraet Steppe]], which is everything past the [[Amnant mountains]] in the west and south. The steppe is criss-crossed by the [[Amnant mountain range]], which historically did not hinder the movement of nomads. In [[Acrola]] the exact limit of the steppe is unclear since the steppe gets drier towards the [[Valmiran Mountains]] and eventually gives way to the [[Red River basin.|Red River basin]]. To the north, the climate is increasingly humid, and the steppe grades into [[wikipedia:Forest|forests]].<ref name="G">{{Cite web |title=Temperate Grassland Ecosystems |url=https://evolution.earthathome.org.est/grasses/temperate-grasslands/#untschalle-steppe |website=Andah at Home}}</ref>

=== Unremite Basin ===
The Unremite Basin is the westernmost part of the Untschalle Steppe, separated from the [[Kametrea Steppe]] by the [[Tusil River]]. It is found in modern-day [[Areoix Lie]], [[Ikzen]], [[Heiso]] and the eastern parts of [[Estijan]].

=== Laraet Steppe ===
The Laraet Steppe aslo valled the Western Steppe begins at the top half of the [[Samarran mountains]], stretching northeast almost to [[Verusa]] and then southwest to [[Lake Arn De Mon]]. Its northern edge was a broad band of forest steppe along the [[Amnant mountains]], which has now been obliterated by the conversion of the whole area to [[wikipedia:Agricultural land|agricultural land]]. The Steppe is a belt of moderately dense population, with many population centres located deep into the steppe, for example, [[Wuzanid]] in [[Darewa]], or [[Nadira]] and [[Vezik]] in [[Lycroa]].

=== Kametrea Steppe===
The Kametrea Steppe makes up most of the Untschalle Steppe in [[Northern Ayuma.]] It extends along the [[Amnant mountains]] to the east. To the south, it grades off into semi-desert and [[wikipedia:desert|desert]], which is interrupted by a great river, the [[Arauya river|Arauya]] (Jalqs), which flows northwest into the [[Rianian Sea]] and provides [[wikipedia:irrigation|irrigation]] for [[wikipedia:agriculture|agriculture]]. The northeast area has a complex history, while in the west, the [[Quaian Steppe]] proper was relatively isolated from the main currents of written history.
